title: Industry unemployment percentile ribbon
intent: Show the monthly median and central eighty percent of unemployment counts across U.S. industries.

ai.create: Create a time-series ribbon from raw industries observations using the tenth and ninetieth percentiles of unemployment with a median center line.
ai.maintain: Change the percentile interval while preserving the original date, industry, and unemployed fields through the reducer, UTC grouping, inferred extents, stable keys, and matching D3 quantile semantics.
